Critique: gamma here is the drag on one particle, which is the bead friction of the dumbbell model (mat-20261121-morozov-spagnolie-2015-complex-fluids) only once a bead is one particle; the page says nothing of hydrodynamic interaction, which the model neglects too. The page is at 'latest', which named 7.2.2 when read.
